fr.sorbonne_u.components.utils.tests

Class TestStep

  • java.lang.Object
    • fr.sorbonne_u.components.utils.tests.TestStep
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TestStepI, java.io.Serializable

    public class TestStep
extends java.lang.Object
implements TestStepI
    The class TestStep defines an action to be performed by a component in a test scenario.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       clock != null
 invariant       componentRIP_URI != null && !componentRIP_URI.isEmpty()
 invariant       instantOfOccurrence != null
 invariant       instantOfOccurrence.isAfter(clock.getStartInstant()) && instantOfOccurrence.isBefore(clock.getEndInstant())
 invariant       stepFunction != null || stepTask != null
 invariant       !(stepFunction != null && stepTask != null)

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2025-11-10

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant

    • Constructor Detail

      • TestStep

        public TestStep(java.lang.String clockURI,
                java.lang.String componentRIP_URI,
                java.time.Instant instantOfOccurrence,
                ComponentI.FComponentTask stepFunction)
        create a component test step to be performed by the component having the given reflection inbound port URI at the given time of occurrence subject to the clock time reference to perform the viven step funciton.

        Contract

         pre     clockURI != null && !clockURI.isEmpty()
 pre     componentRIP_URI != null && !componentRIP_URI.isEmpty()
 pre     instantOfOccurrence != null
 pre     instantOfOccurrence.isAfter(clock.getStartInstant()) && instantOfOccurrence.isBefore(clock.getEndInstant())
 pre     stepFunction != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        clockURI - URI of the clock providing the time reference for the test scenario.
        componentRIP_URI - URI of the reflection inbound port of the component performing the test step.
        instantOfOccurrence - instant of occurrence of the test step.
        stepFunction - a lambda implementing the test step to be performed.

      • executeComponentTestStep

        public void executeComponentTestStep(AbstractComponent performer)
        execute the step for execution on performer.

        Contract

         pre     performer != null
 pre     clock != null
 pre     clock.getClockURI().equals(this.clockURI)
 pre     instantOfOccurrence.isAfter(clock.getStartInstant()) && instantOfOccurrence.isBefore(clock.getEndInstant())
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        performer - the component that must perform the step.

      • planTestStep

        public void planTestStep(AbstractComponent performer,
                         AcceleratedClock clock)
        schedule the step for execution on performer on its schedulable executor service.

        Contract

         pre     performer != null
 pre     performer.getReflectionInboundPortURI().equals(getPerformingEntityURI())
 pre     clock != null
 pre     clock.getClockURI().equals(this.clockURI)
 pre     instantOfOccurrence.isAfter(clock.getStartInstant()) && instantOfOccurrence.isBefore(clock.getEndInstant())
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        performer - the component that must perform the step.
        clock - clock providing the time reference for instants in the test scenario.
